poses.title: Wall lean, look away
poses.howTo: Subject leans one shoulder to the wall, weight on the far foot, chin slightly toward camera then eyes look down the wall line. Hands in pockets or hold jacket lapel.
poses.cameraTip: Shoot 3/4 body, camera at chest height, leave negative space in the look direction.
poses.freeImageSearch: person leaning on brick wall portrait
poses.searchPrompt: person leaning on brick wall portrait

poses.title: Window-light seated profile
poses.howTo: Seat near the window. Body angled 45° to camera, face turned into the light. Hands rest on cup or book; shoulders relaxed.
poses.cameraTip: Expose for the face; let the far side fall slightly darker.
poses.freeImageSearch: portrait by window natural light sitting
poses.searchPrompt: portrait by window natural light sitting

poses.title: Stairs mid-step glance
poses.howTo: One foot two steps up, hand lightly on rail. Pause mid-step and glance back over the shoulder toward camera.
poses.cameraTip: Low angle from below, include 4–6 steps for leading lines.
poses.freeImageSearch: woman on stairs looking back portrait
poses.searchPrompt: woman on stairs looking back portrait

poses.title: Doorway frame lean
poses.howTo: Stand in the doorway, one hand high on the frame, opposite hip soft. Cross one ankle loosely.
poses.cameraTip: Center the subject in the frame; use the door as a natural border.

poses.title: Chair, crossed legs, chin on hand
poses.howTo: Sit sideways on the chair, legs crossed at knee, elbow on thigh, chin lightly on knuckles. Spine long.
poses.cameraTip: Shoot slightly above eye level to slim the seated shape.
poses.freeImageSearch: portrait sitting on chair chin on hand
poses.searchPrompt: portrait sitting on chair chin on hand

poses.title: Park bench long legs
poses.howTo: Sit at one end of the bench, extend legs along the seat or toward camera, torso twisted slightly to face lens. One arm along the bench back.
poses.cameraTip: Wide enough to show bench length; watch background clutter behind the head.
poses.freeImageSearch: person sitting on park bench portrait

poses.title: Railing overlook
poses.howTo: Forearms on railing, weight forward, gaze to the horizon. Soft bend in elbows; hair or coat can move in wind.
poses.cameraTip: Side profile or 3/4; include sky/horizon for scale.
poses.freeImageSearch: person leaning on railing city view
poses.searchPrompt: person leaning on railing city view

poses.title: Bouquet near face
poses.howTo: Hold bouquet at chest or just below chin. Nose almost in petals, eyes to camera or soft closed smile.
poses.cameraTip: Shoot wide open aperture; keep eyes sharp through the blooms.

poses.title: Coffee cup street walk
poses.howTo: Walk toward camera holding cup at mid-chest. Other hand in coat pocket. Natural stride, not posed freeze.
poses.cameraTip: Burst mode; pick the frame with a clean mid-stride.
poses.freeImageSearch: person walking with coffee cup street

poses.title: Jacket over shoulder
poses.howTo: Drape jacket over one shoulder, hold collar with two fingers. Opposite hand in pocket. Strong posture.
poses.cameraTip: Full or 3/4 length; keep vertical lines straight.

poses.title: Hat brim shadow
poses.howTo: Tilt chin up slightly so light under the brim hits the eyes. One hand can touch the hat brim.
poses.cameraTip: Camera slightly below eye line; watch that eyes stay lit.

poses.title: Umbrella over shoulder
poses.howTo: Umbrella rests on shoulder or held high. Body under the canopy, face peeking toward camera.
poses.cameraTip: Expose for face under the umbrella; catch rim light on edges.

poses.title: Lean on car door
poses.howTo: Hip against closed door, one elbow on roof or window ledge, ankles crossed. Look past camera then back.
poses.cameraTip: Avoid distracting reflections; polarizer helps on paint/glass.

poses.title: Bike stand-by
poses.howTo: Straddle or stand beside bike, hands on handlebars. One foot on pedal, relaxed smile.
poses.cameraTip: Include enough bike to read the prop without cutting wheels oddly.

poses.title: Blanket sit in field
poses.howTo: Sit on blanket with knees soft to one side. Hands in grass or holding a book. Optional lie back looking at sky.
poses.cameraTip: Get low; use sky or distant trees as clean background.
poses.freeImageSearch: person sitting on blanket in field

poses.title: Beach wind hair
poses.howTo: Face into the breeze, hair moving. Hands lightly hold dress/jacket or hang natural. Walk slow parallel to water.
poses.cameraTip: Backlight at sunset; expose for skin, let highlights glow.
poses.freeImageSearch: beach portrait wind hair golden hour

poses.title: Tree lean, one knee bent
poses.howTo: Back or shoulder to tree trunk, one knee bent with foot on bark. Hands behind back or holding opposite elbow.
poses.cameraTip: Use dappled light; move until spots don't land as harsh dots on the face.

poses.title: Window sill perch
poses.howTo: Perch on sill if safe, or stand with hip against it. Knees toward camera, torso open to light.
poses.cameraTip: Watch for blown windows; bracket or expose for highlights.

poses.title: Alley walk away glance
poses.howTo: Walk away down the alley center line, then glance back over shoulder. Keep stride natural.
poses.cameraTip: Center composition; use vanishing lines of the alley.
poses.freeImageSearch: person walking in alley looking back

poses.title: Rooftop coat spin
poses.howTo: Hold coat open and turn slowly so fabric flares. Freeze at the peak of the turn for a still.
poses.cameraTip: Burst at peak motion; shutter fast enough to freeze fabric edge.

poses.title: Two friends, matching wall lean
poses.howTo: Both lean on wall a half-step apart. Inner shoulders closer, outer feet kicked forward. Look at each other then camera.
poses.cameraTip: Keep heads at similar height in frame or intentionally stagger for style.

poses.title: Two on stairs, offset levels
poses.howTo: One sits two steps above the other. Upper person rests forearms on knees; lower looks up or both face camera.
poses.cameraTip: Diagonal from lower corner; include rail as a line.

poses.title: Bench conversation lean-in
poses.howTo: Sit angled toward each other mid-bench. One listens, one talks; catch the laugh between prompts.
poses.cameraTip: Shoot from the side so both faces read; shallow depth still keep both eyes.
poses.freeImageSearch: two friends talking on park bench
poses.searchPrompt: two friends talking on park bench

poses.title: Doorway stack peek
poses.howTo: One stands in frame; second peeks from behind or beside with chin on friend's shoulder.
poses.cameraTip: Tight doorway crop; watch for harsh interior mixed light.

poses.title: Shared umbrella walk
poses.howTo: Walk under one umbrella, shoulders touching. Outer free hands in pockets. Chat while walking.
poses.cameraTip: Slightly ahead and to the side; catch faces under the canopy.

poses.title: Cafe table chin hands
poses.howTo: Opposite or adjacent seats. Elbows on table, cups in frame. Lean in as if sharing a secret.
poses.cameraTip: Shoot across table height; include cups as foreground interest.
poses.freeImageSearch: two friends at cafe table coffee

poses.title: Side-by-side railing lookout
poses.howTo: Both forearms on railing, looking same direction, then one turns to the other mid-conversation.
poses.cameraTip: Profile pair shot; leave space ahead of their gaze.
poses.freeImageSearch: two people leaning on railing view

poses.title: Friends at car hood
poses.howTo: Both lean on hood or fender, ankles crossed, facing camera with easy smiles.
poses.cameraTip: Keep faces brighter than reflective paint; avoid cutting the car awkwardly.

poses.title: Picnic blanket face-to-face
poses.howTo: Sit cross-legged facing each other on blanket. Pass flowers or share a book joke for real expressions.
poses.cameraTip: High angle or eye-level on the blanket plane.

poses.title: One bikes, one walks beside
poses.howTo: One slowly rolls bike; friend walks beside holding handlebar or shoulder. Glances between them.
poses.cameraTip: Track sideways; keep both in focus with a bit more depth.

poses.title: Forehead to forehead
poses.howTo: Faces close, foreheads touch, eyes closed or soft. Hands on waist/cheeks. Quiet breath together.
poses.cameraTip: Tight crop on faces; side light or backlight works well.

poses.title: Embrace from behind
poses.howTo: One stands behind, arms around waist/chest. Front person leans back. Both look out, or front looks to camera.
poses.cameraTip: Step to the side so both faces show; don't hide the rear face completely.

poses.title: Walk hand-in-hand
poses.howTo: Hold hands and walk toward or past camera. Prompt: talk about weekend plans so faces stay alive.
poses.cameraTip: Burst; choose stride where both feet look natural.

poses.title: Whisper laugh
poses.howTo: One leans to whisper something funny. Capture the listener's real laugh — tell them to actually say a joke.
poses.cameraTip: Focus on the laughing face; wider enough for both.

poses.title: Gentle dip
poses.howTo: One supports the other's lower back for a small controlled dip. Check comfort first. Hold 2 seconds.
poses.cameraTip: Full body; keep support foot and stance stable in frame.

poses.title: Couple sit close on stairs
poses.howTo: Sit same step or adjacent. Shoulders touch; one head on the other's shoulder. Hands linked low.
poses.cameraTip: Angle from below or side; rail as leading line.

poses.title: Bench lean-on-chest
poses.howTo: One sits back; partner leans into chest. Legs angled same direction. Soft eye contact or closed eyes.
poses.cameraTip: Side 3/4; keep both faces visible.

poses.title: Railing cheek kiss
poses.howTo: Both at railing; one kisses cheek or temple while other smiles toward view or camera.
poses.cameraTip: Backlight rim on hair; expose faces carefully.
poses.freeImageSearch: couple kiss on cheek balcony railing

poses.title: Doorway close press
poses.howTo: One back to door frame; partner steps in close, forehead almost touching. Hands on waist/neck.
poses.cameraTip: Vertical frame; use doorway as border.

poses.title: Window almost-silhouette
poses.howTo: Stand against bright window in a soft hug or forehead touch. Optional tiny fill light on faces if you want detail.
poses.cameraTip: Meter for the window for silhouette, or +fill for romantic glow.

poses.title: Chair: one sits, one perches
poses.howTo: One sits; partner perches on armrest or sits across lap briefly if comfortable. Hands steady for balance.
poses.cameraTip: Full body to show chair support and posture.

poses.title: Bouquet exchange
poses.howTo: One offers bouquet; other receives at chest height. Capture the handoff smile, then both hold together.
poses.cameraTip: Focus on eyes at the moment of handoff.

poses.title: Coffee cup toast
poses.howTo: Clink cups lightly, eye contact, laugh. Works standing on street or seated at cafe.
poses.cameraTip: Include cups in lower third; faces sharp.

poses.title: Shared coat wrap
poses.howTo: Drape one coat or blanket around both shoulders. Pull edges closed; faces close inside the wrap.
poses.cameraTip: Tight upper-body crop; warm color grade optional.

poses.title: Umbrella almost-kiss
poses.howTo: Under umbrella, faces close for an almost-kiss or soft kiss. Hands on waist/umbrella handle.
poses.cameraTip: Faces lit from open side of umbrella; rain streaks bonus if present.

poses.title: Couple on car hood
poses.howTo: Sit on hood only if safe for the car. Legs dangling or tucked; one arm around partner. Look at view then each other.
poses.cameraTip: Wide environmental shot at sunset; watch reflections.
poses.freeImageSearch: couple sitting on car hood sunset

poses.title: Sit in sand, lean together
poses.howTo: Sit in sand, knees soft, shoulders touching. One wraps arm around; feet toward water optional.
poses.cameraTip: Get low to sand level; sunset backlight classic.
poses.freeImageSearch: couple sitting on beach sand sunset
poses.searchPrompt: couple sitting on beach sand sunset

poses.title: Tree wrap hug
poses.howTo: One back to tree; partner closes in for a hug. Foreheads touch; soft knee bend for comfort.
poses.cameraTip: Use even shade or golden edge light through leaves.

poses.title: Field spin hold
poses.howTo: Hold both hands and spin slowly, or one spins the other under an arm. Catch joy mid-turn.
poses.cameraTip: Burst + slight motion blur artistic option; freeze for sharp joy.

poses.title: Alley wall press
poses.howTo: One back to brick; partner leans in with forearm on wall beside head. Intimate but leave a little air if needed.
poses.cameraTip: Vertical; texture of brick as character.

poses.title: Lie on blanket face-to-face
poses.howTo: Lie on sides facing each other on blanket. Noses close; hands soft between them.
poses.cameraTip: Top-down or very low side angle; watch harsh overhead sun.
poses.freeImageSearch: couple lying on blanket facing each other

poses.title: Bike stop kiss
poses.howTo: Bike between or beside them. Brief kiss or forehead touch over the handlebars.
poses.cameraTip: Include bike as story prop without covering faces.

poses.title: Playful hat steal
poses.howTo: One wears hat; partner steals it onto their own head. Capture the laugh mid-swap.
poses.cameraTip: Candid timing over perfect posing.

poses.title: Shared book lean
poses.howTo: Share one book. Heads lean together looking at the page, then look up to camera.
poses.cameraTip: Over-shoulder or front 3/4; book text optional blur.

poses.title: Waterfront lean-in talk
poses.howTo: Stand at water edge or rail. Turn inward, noses close, soft conversation pose.
poses.cameraTip: Put horizon at upper third; reflections in water if calm.

poses.title: Couch cozy tangle
poses.howTo: Sit or recline on couch; legs tangled, blanket optional. Forehead touch or quiet laugh.
poses.cameraTip: Use window as key light; tidy background cushions.
poses.freeImageSearch: couple on couch cozy at home

poses.title: Rooftop point-and-look
poses.howTo: One points at a distant building; both look that way, then turn back laughing to camera.
poses.cameraTip: Wide enough for skyline context.

poses.title: Hand on hip power stand
poses.howTo: Weight on back leg, front knee soft, hand on hip, other hand relaxed. Chin slightly forward.
poses.cameraTip: Straight-on or slight low angle for confidence.

poses.title: Steps, elbows on knees
poses.howTo: Sit mid-staircase, elbows on knees, hands loose. Look into lens or past camera.
poses.cameraTip: Eye-level with seated subject; compress background with longer lens.

poses.title: V-up then open to camera
poses.howTo: Start facing each other (V). Then open like a door to face camera while keeping near shoulders close. Classic couple reset pose.
poses.cameraTip: Full body first, then tighter after they settle.

poses.title: Height stack hug
poses.howTo: Taller stands behind shorter; arms wrap. Shorter leans back. Use height instead of hiding it.
poses.cameraTip: Side angle so both faces show.

poses.title: Chair + single stem
poses.howTo: Sit backwards or sideways on chair, hold one stem near collarbone. Soft gaze down then to camera.
poses.cameraTip: Simple wall; let flower color be the accent.

poses.title: Synchronized small jump
poses.howTo: Count 3 and small jump together, arms free. Silly energy over perfect form.
poses.cameraTip: Fast shutter; burst at apex.

poses.title: Piggyback short hold
poses.howTo: Safe short piggyback if strength allows. Carrier smiles forward; rider holds shoulders and looks to camera.
poses.cameraTip: Full body; ensure footing is stable before shooting.

poses.title: Golden hour lens flare stand
poses.howTo: Place sun just off frame behind shoulder. Subject looks toward camera; slight head tilt.
poses.cameraTip: Spot meter face; allow intentional flare.

poses.title: Sunset lean on horizon
poses.howTo: Stand close, lean heads together, place bodies on the bright horizon line for glow or soft silhouette.
poses.cameraTip: Shoot against the sun; decide silhouette vs exposed faces.
